ops.title: ccx-3 lane handoff: v0.66.6 (#208, #209) and v0.66.7 (#210, #211)
ops.body:
Shipped by lane ccx-ship-new-branch-json-3 on 2026-10-01; all merged, both releases verified (10 assets, tap updated, descriptor commit on main).

- #208 d023fac: plain-git `stack restack` fetches only trunk, PR base, --parent; refuses a ref ls-remote does not report (`restack: <remote> has no branch <name>`).
- #209 e2b69e8: plain-git ship fetches only its branch and trunk via stackRemoteHeads; shipPRBase = `ls-remote --heads` ∩ `rev-list <branch> ^<remote>/<trunk>`, nearest by commit count, refreshes the trunk ref first (an --amend ship never fetches). v0.66.6, release run 36849880972.
- #210 52fef74: `ship --amend` leases on the remote head when it equals the pre-amend head or a local commit the branch reflog reaches (shipAmendLease); gitReflogHolds now runs with GIT_NO_REPLACE_OBJECTS=1, GIT_GRAFT_FILE=/dev/null, GIT_NO_LAZY_FETCH=1 (a replace ref or graft could otherwise splice a foreign head into the reflog and authorize the force; reproduced). Deleted the cli-local gitRemoteFor: ship and push now use vcs.GitRemoteFor, which maps branch.<b>.remote=. to origin. v0.66.6's changelog claimed that for ship/push already; it was true only for restack until v0.66.7.
- #211 3aae9f4: gt-lane `ship --no-push` fetches the trunk ref (gtTrunkRef) and re-reads gt state before its in-place restack. Mechanism: gt state reads trunk's head from refs/remotes/origin/<trunk>; a parent recorded as restacked onto a newer trunk reads as off-parent against a stale ref and was replayed back onto it as a second copy. v0.66.7, release run 36856311665.

Accepted risks (named in the PR bodies):
- restack trusts a recorded origin/HEAD under non-default remote.<name>.followRemoteHEAD=always, as push does since #207.
- shipAmendLease reads the remote head through the fetch URL while push uses pushurl; a split push destination refuses, never forces wrongly (same assumption as push/restack).
- #210's partial-clone lazy-fetch guard has no regression test.

Owner install: brew update && brew upgrade yasyf/tap/ccx
